The wide-diameter opening simplifies every step of bottle preparation. Fill, clean, and prepare milk or formula quickly without struggling with narrow openings. This design saves time during busy feeding schedules while maintaining proper hygiene standards. The large opening accommodates bottle brushes easily, ensuring thorough cleaning after each use.

Equipped with an anti-colic nipple, this bottle reduces air intake during feeding. Less air means less gas, burping, and discomfort for your infant. The nipple design promotes a natural latch and steady milk flow, helping prevent common feeding issues that disrupt sleep and cause fussiness.

Ergonomic and Practical Construction

The ergonomic shape allows both parents and babies to hold the bottle comfortably during feeding sessions. Made from durable, high-quality material, this bottle withstands daily use, sterilization, and frequent washing without degrading. The non-toxic construction ensures your baby's safety with every feeding.

Key Benefits:

  • Anti-Colic Nipple: Reduces gas and spit-up for a comfortable feeding experience
  • Large Diameter Design: Easy to clean, refill, and prepare milk or formula
  • Safe Materials: BPA-free, non-toxic, and baby-friendly construction
  • Easy to Hold: Ergonomic design for parents and babies
  • Durable & Practical: Ideal for daily feeding and long-term use

The silicone construction is flexible yet sturdy, protecting against cracks and breaks common with plastic alternatives.

The spill-proof design gives parents peace of mind whether at home, traveling, or at daycare. The secure seal prevents leaks in diaper bags and backpacks, making it ideal for families on the go.

Ergonomic Design for Small Hands

The bottle's ergonomic design fits comfortably in toddler-sized hands, making it easy for young children to grip and hold independently. This child-friendly size promotes self-feeding skills and confidence during the transition from bottles to cups. The lightweight construction ensures toddlers can handle it without strain.

Versatile for Multiple Beverages

Perfect for milk, water, juice, or other beverages, this feeding bottle adapts to your child's hydration needs throughout the day. The soft silicone straw allows for comfortable sipping without hard plastic edges, making it suitable for children at various developmental stages.

Totvana Baby Petal Nipple Feeding Bottle

The Totvana Baby Petal Nipple Feeding Bottle provides a natural feeding experience for infants. Designed with a soft petal-shaped nipple, this bottle mimics breastfeeding to help your baby latch easily and transition smoothly between breast and bottle.

Constructed from BPA-free, food-grade materials, this feeding bottle prioritizes your baby's safety. The non-toxic composition makes it suitable for newborns and toddlers, giving parents confidence during every feeding session.

Anti-Colic Valve System

The integrated anti-colic valve reduces air intake during feeding, minimizing gas, spit-up, and tummy discomfort. This design feature helps prevent colic symptoms and promotes a more comfortable feeding experience for your infant.

Ergonomic Design Features

The bottle's ergonomic design makes handling simple for parents during feeding time. Lightweight construction allows for easy one-handed operation, while the shape provides a secure grip. The wide-mouth opening simplifies filling and cleaning, ensuring hygienic use.

Natural Feeding Experience

The petal-shaped nipple texture encourages natural tongue movement and promotes proper oral development. The nipple design allows for smooth milk flow control, preventing choking while maintaining an adequate feeding pace for infants.

Versatile Usage

This feeding bottle works for daily milk feeding at home, daycare, or while traveling. The durable construction withstands regular use and sterilization, maintaining safety standards over time. Compatible with standard bottle warmers and sterilizers for convenient preparation.

Key Benefits:

  • Safe & Non-Toxic: BPA-free and food-grade materials
  • Comfortable Feeding: Petal-shaped nipple for natural latch and smooth milk flow
  • Anti-Colic Design: Reduces gas, spit-up, and tummy discomfort
  • Easy to Hold & Clean: Ergonomic, lightweight bottle design
  • Ideal for Infants: Suitable for newborns and toddlers

The Totvana Baby Petal Nipple Feeding Bottle combines safety, comfort, and practical design for stress-free feeding sessions. The BPA-free construction and anti-colic features address common feeding concerns while the natural nipple shape supports your baby's feeding development.
